description: This Java class defines a non-serializable command object used for multi-stage processing within a connectivity messaging system. It encapsulates a sequence of actions, commands, events, and responses, facilitating asynchronous and synchronous processing by an actor. The class provides methods for creating, modifying, and iterating over staged commands, and is tightly integrated with a larger messaging and connection management framework.

classes.name: StagedCommand
classes.description: A final class representing a staged command that supports multi-stage processing with associated commands, events, responses, sender info, and a sequence of connection actions. Implements the ConnectivityCommand interface and supports iteration over its actions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new StagedCommand with specified command, event, response, and actions.

methods.name: dummyEvent
methods.description: Returns a static dummy connectivity event used as a placeholder.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the wrapped connectivity command.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns the event associated with the staged command.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response headers to be sent or forwarded.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the original sender of the command.

methods.name: withSenderUnlessDefined
methods.description: Creates a new staged command with a specified sender if one is not already defined.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Returns a copy of this staged command with a new response.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Implements interface method to get the connection entity ID.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Implements interface method to get the command's category.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Implements interface method to get Ditto headers associated with the command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new staged command instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string of the command.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the command.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on command, event, response, sender, and actions.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality by comparing command, event, response, sender, and actions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the staged command including all its fields.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Indicates if there are remaining actions.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns a new staged command with the next action removed from the sequence.

methods.name: nextAction
methods.description: Returns the next action without modifying the sequence.

methods.name: getActionsAsQueue
methods.description: Private helper method to convert actions collection to a queue for iteration.
